title: A low-ammonium consumption method for preparing high-purity V2O5 from vanadium-rich liquids with high impurity content
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,12940-12953
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01838B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Bingjie Sun, Jing Huang, Yimin Zhang, Pengcheng Hu
A novel process for high-purity V2O5 production was developed using D2EHPA saponification extraction, hydrolysis precipitation, and ammonium salt purification. This method achieves >99.92% purity while cutting ammonium consumption by 91.67%.
